notes: DiscoFlate v3.74.0 — typing in the chat box no longer fires the read-only-scene toast, the operator is never cooldown- or use-limited from the app's own chat box, a command that did nothing (its event was on cooldown) no longer announces itself, and every round of a looping event can announce what it did via the new 'notify' action row — e.g. 'AireGasm added 20s to Low-Speed Pump · Roulette 2/3'.
